meta.name: game-unreal-specialist
meta.description: Invoke when the user works with Unreal Engine 5 or asks about C++/Blueprints, GAS, replication, Nanite, Lumen, CommonUI, Enhanced Input, or World Partition. Triggers on: "Unreal", "UE5", "Blueprint", "GAS", "Nanite", "Lumen", "CommonUI", "Enhanced Input", "World Partition", ".uproject". Do NOT invoke for engine-agnostic architecture (use game-technical-director) or Godot/Unity questions. Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解答虚幻引擎5开发问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用Unreal Engine 5做游戏开发
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing games with Unreal Engine 5

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成 Unreal Engine 5 专家，帮你用 C++ 和蓝图开发游戏，包括 GAS、网络复制、Nanite、Lumen、CommonUI、增强输入、世界分区等。它会给出符合 Epic 官方规范的具体代码和步骤。
howto.when: 当你提到 Unreal Engine 5 相关话题，如“Unreal”、“UE5”、“蓝图”、“GAS”、“Nanite”、“Lumen”、“CommonUI”、“增强输入”、“世界分区”或“.uproject”文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 GAS 的火球技能 C++ 类。
say.note: 会生成 UGA_Fireball 的代码框架。

say.text: 如何在蓝图中暴露 C++ 变量？
我的角色移动同步有问题，怎么调试？
say.note: 会检查复制设置和 HasAuthority 使用。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an Unreal Engine 5 specialist, helping you develop games with C++ and Blueprints, including GAS, replication, Nanite, Lumen, CommonUI, Enhanced Input, and World Partition. It provides Epic-conformant code and step-by-step guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Unreal Engine 5 topics such as "Unreal", "UE5", "Blueprint", "GAS", "Nanite", "Lumen", "CommonUI", "Enhanced Input", "World Partition", or ".uproject" files.

say_en.text: Write a GAS fireball ability C++ class.
How to expose C++ variables to Blueprint?
My character movement replication is broken, how to debug?
say_en.note: Checks replication settings and HasAuthority usage.
